title: docs: add concise community model naming tips
author: TRDEFI
pr_body_excerpt:
Closes #12885

- Adds one short naming paragraph to the existing Publish a Model guide.
- Links the Model ID helper in the Add Model form to that paragraph.
- Keeps naming guidance separate from validation and enforcement.

gist.headline: Names need good roots
gist.blurb: Community model names now have a small patch of guidance before they grow wild. The Model ID helper points directly to it, because a friendly signpost beats guessing.
gist.summary: Added a concise naming paragraph to the Publish a Model guide and linked the Add Model form’s Model ID helper directly to it, while keeping guidance separate from validation rules.
gist.impact: Community publishers get clearer Model ID naming conventions exactly where they choose an ID, making model listings easier to create and recognize.
gist.visual_concept: Polli acts as a patient garden keeper labeling small code-plants with neat Model ID name tags, while a friendly CRT monitor robot holds a guidebook and points to a signpost labeled “NAMING TIPS.” The scene represents lightweight guidance rather than strict enforcement: a welcoming garden path, labels, and organized sprouts.
